name: jethro
description: jethro: Claude Code plugins for running many sessions at once: session titles, a session guide, a stale-session sweep and an artifact explorer

plugins.name: session-titles
plugins.description: Keep each session titled '<origin> · <focus>': a frozen origin plus a plain-words focus refreshed on every prompt

plugins.name: session-sweep
plugins.description: Close stale Claude Code background sessions on demand and every 12 hours, and ask you about the unclear ones

plugins.name: session-guide
plugins.description: A guide session that tracks every stream in one ledger, routes worker decisions to you, and hands off cleanly

plugins.name: jethro
plugins.description: Installs the whole suite: session-titles, session-sweep and session-guide
